title: Optimizing learning for control of human-machine interfaces
title_zh: 优化人机界面控制的学习方法
abstract: Human-machine interfaces, such as augmented reality devices, hand prostheses, and brain-computer interfaces, are increasingly being used in neurorehabilitation. In this issue of Neuron, Vassiliadis et al.1 examine the interaction between closed-loop continuous reinforcement and sensory feedback in learning of human-machine interface control.
abstract_zh: 人机界面，如增强现实设备、手部义肢和脑机接口，正日益应用于神经康复。本期《Neuron》杂志中，Vassiliadis 等人1 研究了闭环连续强化与感官反馈在学习人机界面控制过程中的相互作用。
